conclusionEvidence: The private-runtime host WRITE_DAC descendant grant resolves the previously absent executable profile ACEs; standard-user executables now have inherited read/execute profile ACE mask 1179817 flags 16.

The same independent medium-integrity non-administrator suite passes all 20 cases, including Node/Python children, fork capacity, memory exhaustion, helper cleanup, terminal, Office conversion and policy delivery.
The AppContainer cannot replace the runtime executable or read-only input DACL: both SetNamedSecurityInfoW attacks return ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (5).
Profile grants, Job limits and network capabilities remain unchanged.
remaining: Actual malicious macro and real external-link document behavior validation remains outstanding; existing policy-delivery tests do not replace it.
Local unsigned-helper execution remains blocked by Windows application control and was not attempted.
